name: meirdick/prism-workers-ai
description: Cloudflare Workers AI provider for Laravel AI SDK and Prism PHP. Native Laravel AI gateway with no Prism dependency, plus optional Prism integration.

suggest.laravel/ai: Required for agent() integration. Native gateway works on ^0.5 || ^0.6 || ^0.7 with no Prism involvement. Recommended for new projects.
suggest.prism-php/prism: Required for Prism::text()->using('workers-ai', ...). Compatible with ^0.99 || ^0.100. Optional as of v0.5.0 — only needed if you use the Prism integration.
